L'agliata, aglio pestato sciolto nell'ac: Agliata, pounded garlic loosened with vinegar, is an ancient condiment of Genoese cooking. Emanuele Rossi uses it on swedes in «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865, no. 246).

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 99: ravioli of capon breast, brains, sweetbreads and chicken liver, to be cooked in broth or served dry with cheese and butter.

Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 132: in the Genoese recipe book these ravioli of chicken, pigeon, veal and borage are called «alla siciliana» (Sicilian-style).

Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 150: Genoese-style risotto is enriched halfway through cooking with beef brains and marrow and finished with saffron and Parmigiano.

Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 306: anchovies are scaled in fresh water, opened, dipped in egg with garlic and parsley and fried in breadcrumbs. Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 420: fresh anchovies are cooked slowly in a pan with oil, garlic and a little fennel, 10-12 minutes on each side, turning them one by one once they have cooled a little. Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 160: the taglierini of no. 136, cooked in water and dressed, instead of with meat sauce, «con pèsto d'aglio e basilico e col formaggio parmigiano» (with garlic and basil pesto and Parmigiano cheese).
Impastare la farina 00 con le uova, l'ac: Knead the 00 flour with the eggs, lukewarm water and a pinch of salt for 10 minutes, into a hard, smooth dough.

Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, “La vera cuciniera genovese” (1865), recipe 161: the cooked taglierini are tossed in a large dish with a big piece of fresh butter and plenty of Parmesan; the butter can be melted first by holding the dish over the pot.

Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 520: the round of fresh tuna studded with rosemary, brushed with oil, salted and roasted on the grill like sturgeon.

Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 521: «tonno arrosto con marinaggio» (roast tuna with a marinade), left for two hours in oil, parsley, onion, garlic, cloves and lemon and then roasted on the grill with breadcrumbs.

Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 557: it is made like the torta pasqualina no. 554, with paper-thin oiled pastry sheets, using onions browned in butter with dried mushrooms and Parmigiano instead of chard; «si può tralasciare le uova» (the eggs can be left out).

Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 561: spinach tossed in butter with onion and parsley, seasoned with Parmigiano and enclosed between the pastry sheets as in the torta pasqualina no. 554.

Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 415: red mullet in a pan in a garlic soffritto with a little fennel, finished in tomato sauce; to turn them without breaking them, the pan is taken off the heat and left to cool a little.

Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 417: red mullet in a pan with oil, salt, lemon, capers and a few spoonfuls of white wine, cooked slowly and served hot.

Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 545: the eggs poured whole into butter that has turned a fine golden colour, turned with the slotted spoon and well browned without overcooking them; «bisogna cuocere soltanto due o tre uova per volta» (you must cook only two or three eggs at a time).

Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 175: the breast and the muscular parts are put into cold water like beef, with a shorter cooking time; if they are cooked together, the veal is taken out as soon as it is done and kept covered with hot broth. Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 360: veal in small pieces in a soffritto of butter and onion, moistened with broth and bound at the end with two or three egg yolks beaten with parsley and lemon juice, taking the casserole off at once «onde l'uovo si condensi senza però rapprendersi» (so that the egg thickens without setting).

Spennellare la superficie con l'altro al: Brush the top with the other beaten egg white.

Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, “La vera cuciniera genovese” (1865), recipe 436: veal breast, udder and sweetbread browned, chopped and pounded with breadcrumb, four yolks and one white, Parmesan and spices, alternated with beaten slices of lean meat and cooked with heat below and above. The recipe card leaves out the udder and spinal marrow, almost impossible to find today, and the oven replaces the embers on the lid.

Lessare il sedano e la carota 10 minuti: Boil the celery and carrot for 10 minutes and chop them; scald the sweetbread for 5 minutes, skin it and slice it together with the veal topside.
Distribuire a strati animella, fesa e ve: Spread the sweetbread, topside and vegetables in layers and cover everything with the slices of prosciutto crudo.
Arrotolare stretta la fetta come un gros: Roll the slice up tightly like a large salami and tie it closely with string, especially at the ends.
In una casseruola sciogliere il burro e: In a casserole melt the butter and brown the roll for 15 minutes on every side, sprinkling it with the dry white wine.
Bagnare col brodo (se non lo avete, acqu: Moisten with broth (if you have none, hot salted water), cover and cook over a low heat for 2 hours 30 minutes, turning it now and then.

Servire freddo come un salume, oppure ca: Serve cold like a cured meat, or hot with its juices; wrapped, it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 437: a large one-kilo slice of lean meat, beaten, covered with veal udder and breast, sweetbread, lean meat, boiled celery and carrot and 72 g of ham, rolled «in guisa da formare un grosso salame» (so as to form a large salami) and cooked for two and a half hours; «eccellente vivanda da mangiarsi fredda tagliata a fette» (an excellent dish to be eaten cold, cut in slices), and some add diced truffles.
Legare la noce di vitello con lo spago e: Tie the veal cushion with string and salt it all over.
In una casseruola sciogliere il burro a: In a casserole melt the butter over a medium heat and brown the meat for 15-20 minutes, turning it as it colours.

Abbassare il fuoco, coprire e cuocere pi: Lower the heat, cover and cook gently for 1 hour 15 minutes, turning the meat and moistening now and then.

Togliere la carne, lasciarla riposare 10: Remove the meat, let it rest for 10 minutes and slice it.
Servire con il fondo di cottura e le pat: Serve with the cooking juices and the potatoes; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 470: a fine piece of veal, salted, browned in butter on every side, moistened with a few spoonfuls of broth and finished cooking slowly in a covered casserole; it is served with salad and potatoes.
Legare la lombata di vitello stretta con: Tie the veal loin tightly with string, all the way round, so that it keeps its shape.
Thread it onto the spit right through the middle.
Melt the butter over a low heat.
Ungere la carne col burro fuso e spolver: Brush the meat with the melted butter and sprinkle it with salt.
Metterla a girare vicino alla brace viva: Set it turning close to bright embers, or in the oven with the rotisserie at 220 °C, with a drip pan underneath.

È pronta quando uno stecchino entra faci: It is ready when a toothpick goes in easily and the juice runs clear.
Lasciarla riposare 10 minuti, togliere l: Leave it to rest for 10 minutes, remove the string and slice it.
Servire calda col fondo della leccarda;: Serve hot with the juices from the drip pan; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, “La vera cuciniera genovese” (1865), recipe 471: leg, loin or fillet tied tightly, rubbed with melted butter and salted, turned near a good fire and basted often; it is done “when you can easily pierce it with a skewer”.
Legare la coscia di vitello con lo spago: Tie the leg of veal with string and salt it.
Tagliare la cipolla in quarti e il sedan: Cut the onion into quarters and the celery into pieces.
In una casseruola sciogliere il burro e: In a casserole melt the butter and lard and put in the meat with the onion and celery.
Rosolare a fuoco medio 20 minuti, girand: Brown over a medium heat for 20 minutes, turning the meat and sprinkling it several times with the dry white wine, until golden; keep a little wine aside.
Pelare i pomodori maturi, togliere i sem: Peel the ripe tomatoes, remove the seeds and cut them into small pieces; clean the fresh mushrooms and slice them.

Togliere la carne, passare il fondo al s: Remove the meat, push the juices through a sieve and heat them again.
Affettare la carne e servirla calda col: Slice the meat and serve it hot with its sauce; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 473, which refers to no. 27 (Veal sauce): leg of veal browned in butter and veal fat with onion and celery, sprinkled with white wine, then tomatoes and fresh mushrooms, without the broth and flour needed when plenty of sauce is wanted for dressing the soup.
In una casseruola dal fondo spesso, o in: In a heavy-bottomed saucepan, or in a bowl over a bain-marie, whisk the yolks with the sugar for 3 minutes, until pale.
Unire il vino Madera a filo, sempre frul: Add the Madeira in a thin stream, still whisking.
Mettere sul fuoco basso e frullare di co: Put over a low heat and whisk constantly for 8-10 minutes, until the zabaione thickens and coats the spoon, without letting it boil.
Versarlo in una ciotola e farlo raffredd: Pour it into a bowl and leave it to cool, stirring now and then, then keep it in the fridge for 2 hours.

Senza gelatiera, metterlo in freezer in: Without an ice-cream maker, put it in the freezer in a shallow container and stir it with a fork every 30 minutes for 3 hours.
Trasferirlo negli stampini o in un conte: Transfer it to small moulds or a container and keep it in the freezer for at least 1 hour.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 640: eighteen egg yolks whisked with three hectograms of sugar and a bottle of Madeira, thickened over the heat without boiling, cooled and frozen in the sorbet maker, also in the moulds for «pezzi gelati» (ice-cream shapes). This version reduces the quantity to a third.

Portare a bollore e schiumare per i prim: Bring to the boil and skim for the first 10 minutes.
Cuocere a fuoco basso 3 ore, finché la c: Cook over a low heat for 3 hours, until the rind is very soft.
Scolare zampetti e cotenne e tagliare le: Drain the trotters and rinds and cut the rinds into strips.
Servire caldi con la senape a parte; si: Serve hot with the mustard on the side; they keep in the fridge for 3 days in their broth, which sets into a jelly.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, “La vera cuciniera genovese” (1865), recipe 177: trotters and rinds cleaned with boiling water, boiled with an onion, a few cloves, two cloves of garlic, salt and pepper, and served with a spicy sauce or mustard.

Scolarli, disossarli e tagliarli a pezze: Drain them, bone them and cut them into small pieces.
Chop the spring onions and parsley.
In una casseruola sciogliere il burro e: In a casserole melt the butter and put in the trotters, spring onions and parsley with salt, pepper and a ladle of broth (if you have none, the boiling liquid).
Cuocere a fuoco medio 15 minuti, finché: Cook over a medium heat for 15 minutes, until the liquid has reduced a little.
Unire la passata di pomodoro e cuocere a: Add the tomato passata and cook for another 15 minutes.
Sbattere i tuorli con il parmigiano grat: Beat the yolks with the grated Parmigiano and cinnamon.
Togliere dal fuoco, versare i tuorli e m: Take off the heat, pour in the yolks and stir well for 1 minute, until the sauce turns creamy.
Servire subito assai caldo; non va scald: Serve at once, very hot; it must not be reheated.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 341: boned calf's or pig's trotters, in a casserole with butter, spring onions, parsley and a little broth, then meat or tomato sauce, and when taking them off two beaten egg yolks, Parmigiano and a little cinnamon.
Lavare le zucchine lunghe e tagliarle a: Wash the long courgettes and cut them into very thin slices, 2 mm.
In una casseruola larga mettere l'olio,: In a wide casserole put the oil, garlic and courgettes.
Condire con l'origano secco, sale e pepe: Season with the dried oregano, salt and pepper.
Cuocere a fuoco vivo 12-15 minuti, mesco: Cook over a high heat for 12-15 minutes, stirring often.

Servirle calde o tiepide come contorno;: Serve them hot or warm as a side dish; they keep in the fridge for 2 days.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 236: use the courgettes that are «bislunghi, che sono i migliori» (long, which are the best), and cook them «a gran fuoco sino a che sieno quasi prosciugati» (over a high heat until almost dried out), as is done with mushrooms.
Tagliare le zucchine lunghe in quattro p: Cut the long courgettes into four lengthways and then into 6 cm pieces; wash them in fresh water and drain them.
Mettere le zucchine in una pentola con l: Put the courgettes in a pot with the oil, vinegar, garlic, dried oregano, salt and pepper.
Coprire e cuocere a fuoco basso 20 minut: Cover and cook over a low heat for 20 minutes, until tender.
Pulire le acciughe sotto sale sotto l'ac: Clean the salted anchovies under running water, removing the bone.
Versare il liquido di cottura delle zucc: Pour the courgette cooking liquid into a small pan and melt the anchovies in it over a low heat for 2 minutes, crushing them.
Rimettere l'intingolo sulle zucchine e m: Pour the sauce back over the courgettes and stir gently.
Far riprendere il bollore per 1 minuto e: Bring back to the boil for 1 minute and take off the heat.
Servirle tiepide come contorno; in frigo: Serve them warm as a side dish; they keep in the fridge for 2 days.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 237: the quartered courgettes are cooked «in tutto come abbiam detto pei carciofi» (exactly as we said for artichokes) in salmì (recipe 221), that is with oil, a little vinegar, garlic, oregano and anchovies melted in the sauce.
Lavare le zucchine medie e tagliarle a m: Wash the medium courgettes and cut them in half lengthways.
Adagiarvi le zucchine con il taglio vers: Lay the courgettes in it cut side up and salt them.
Cuocerle a fuoco medio-basso 12-15 minut: Cook them over a medium-low heat for 12-15 minutes, until well browned underneath.

Cuocere 2-3 minuti, finché l'uovo si rap: Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the egg sets.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 238: the eggs are beaten «unitamente a poco sale e poc'acqua» (together with a little salt and a little water) and the pan is tilted on every side so that the egg spreads over the whole bottom.

Rosolare la polpa di vitello a pezzi e l: Brown the veal in pieces and the sweetbreads with 70 g of butter over a medium heat for 10 minutes.
Ammollare la mollica di pane in poco bro: Soak the breadcrumb in a little of the ready-made meat broth and squeeze it.
Tritare finissimi carne, animelle e moll: Very finely chop the meat, sweetbreads and breadcrumb into a paste.
Unire 3 uova intere e il tuorlo del quar: Add 3 whole eggs and the yolk of the fourth, half the grated Parmigiano, the nutmeg and the salt, keeping the egg white aside; knead for 3 minutes.
Formare polpettine grandi come una noce: Shape walnut-sized meatballs and dip them in the beaten egg white.
In un tegame largo soffriggere la cipoll: In a wide pan fry the chopped small onion and parsley with the remaining butter and a pinch of salt for 4 minutes.
Unire le polpettine e cuocerle coperte a: Add the meatballs and cook them covered over a low heat for 30 minutes, turning them, until golden.
Bagnarle con 200 ml di brodo e cuocere a: Moisten them with 200 ml of broth and cook for another 10 minutes.
Tostare il pane raffermo a fette sottili: Toast the stale bread in thin slices on the grill for 1-2 minutes on each side, until crisp, and put them in the tureen with the meatballs.
Versare sopra il brodo rimasto bollente: Pour the remaining boiling broth over them and serve with the rest of the Parmigiano; cooked meatballs keep in the fridge for 2 days.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 85: the little meatballs of veal, udder and sweetbreads are cooked «con poco fuoco sotto e molto sopra mediante un testo di ferro» (with little heat below and plenty above by means of an iron lid) and served on the toasted slices of bread.
Pulire i navoni, tagliarli a pezzi, less: Trim the swedes, cut them into pieces, boil them in salted water for 15 minutes and put them in fresh water.
Pulire i fagiolini piccoli, il cavolo ca: Trim the small green beans, the small white cabbage, the squash and the potatoes; cut the green beans, squash and potatoes into pieces and tear the cabbage into shreds.
Lessarli insieme in acqua salata 8 minut: Boil them together in salted water for 8 minutes, until half cooked.
Scolare tutto in un colapasta insieme ai: Drain everything in a colander together with the swedes.
Portare a bollore il brodo di carne pron: Bring the ready-made meat broth to the boil and tip in the vegetables, the fresh peas, and the carrot and celery in small pieces.
Pulire i carciofi, tagliarli a fette e r: Trim the artichokes, slice them and brown them in the butter for 5 minutes.

Tostare il pane raffermo a fette sulla g: Toast the stale bread in slices on the grill for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crisp, and arrange them in the tureen.
Versare sopra la zuppa e servire subito: Pour the soup over the top and serve at once with the grated Parmigiano; without bread it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 86: a spring soup with all the green vegetables of the Genoese kitchen garden, from swedes to «piccolissimi» (tiny) peas, finished with eight artichokes browned in butter.

Strizzarli forte con le mani e tritarli: Squeeze them hard with your hands and chop them with the mezzaluna.
Tagliare la pancetta salata a dadini pic: Cut the salted pancetta into very small dice.

Sbattere le uova con metà del parmigiano: Beat the eggs with half the grated Parmigiano and the chopped marjoram.
Versarle nel brodo mescolando e lasciare: Pour them into the broth, stirring, and let it boil for 2 minutes, so that they bind with the lettuce.
Versare sopra la zuppa e servire con il: Pour the soup over the top and serve with the remaining Parmigiano; it does not keep.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 87: the boiled lettuces are squeezed «con ambe le mani» (with both hands) and the eight eggs beaten with the cheese and marjoram are stirred into the broth «rimescolando colla mestola» (stirring with the ladle).
Togliere ai cavoli cappucci piccoli le f: Remove the damaged leaves and the central heart from the small white cabbages.
Lessarli interi in acqua salata 8 minuti: Boil them whole in salted water for 8 minutes and squeeze them gently without breaking them.
Rosolare la polpa di vitello a pezzi nel: Brown the veal in pieces in the butter over a medium heat for 12 minutes and chop it finely.

Cuocere i cavoli nel brodo di carne pron: Cook the cabbages in the ready-made meat broth over a low heat for 35-40 minutes, until tender.
Tostare il pane casereccio a fette sulla: Toast the country bread in slices on the grill for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crisp, and arrange them in the tureen.
Versare sopra brodo e cavoli e servire c: Pour the broth and cabbages over the top and serve with the remaining Parmigiano; it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 90: the white cabbages are prepared like the stuffed lettuces in broth (recipes 88 and 89), with the same filling of veal, garlic, ricotta and marjoram.
Rosolare la polpa di vitello a pezzi in: Brown the veal in pieces in 10 g of butter for 8 minutes and leave it to cool slightly.
Ammollare i funghi secchi in acqua tiepi: Soak the dried mushrooms in lukewarm water for 15 minutes and squeeze them; soak the breadcrumb in a little of the ready-made meat broth and squeeze it.
Tritare finissimi carne, mollica, funghi: Very finely chop the meat, breadcrumb, mushrooms, pine nuts, marjoram, parsley and garlic.
Unire metà del parmigiano grattugiato, 2: Add half the grated Parmigiano, 2 eggs and the salt and work into a paste.
Tagliare il pane in cassetta a rombi, to: Cut the sandwich loaf into diamonds, toast them in the oven at 200 °C for 4-5 minutes, until just golden, and spread the filling on top and underneath.
Passare i crostini nell'uovo rimasto sba: Dip the croutons in the remaining beaten egg and fry them in the remaining butter over a medium heat, 3 minutes on each side.
Intanto portare a bollore il brodo e cuo: Meanwhile bring the broth to the boil and cook in it for 15 minutes the thinly sliced artichokes, fresh peas, asparagus tips, and celery and carrot in small pieces.
Mettere i crostini fritti nella zuppiera: Put the fried croutons in the tureen.
Versarci sopra il brodo con le verdure e: Pour the broth with the vegetables over them and serve at once with the remaining Parmigiano; it does not keep.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 91: the toasted bread «mostacciuoli» (diamonds) are spread on top and underneath, coated in egg white and fried in butter, then covered with broth full of spring vegetables.
Lavare gli spinaci, cuocerli in pentola: Wash the spinach, cook it in a pot without water for 5 minutes, squeeze it and chop it.
Ammollare i funghi secchi in acqua tiepi: Soak the dried mushrooms in lukewarm water for 15 minutes and squeeze them.
Tritare la cipolla, il prezzemolo, la ca: Chop the onion, parsley, carrot and mushrooms; pound the pine nuts in the mortar.

Unire gli spinaci, salare e cuocere 5 mi: Add the spinach, salt and cook for 5 minutes.
Versare il brodo di carne pronto e far b: Pour in the ready-made meat broth and boil for 10 minutes.
Tagliare il pane raffermo a bastoncini e: Cut the stale bread into sticks and fry it in the butter for frying until golden.
Nella zuppiera sbattere i tuorli con il: In the tureen beat the yolks with the milk and grated Parmigiano, add the bread and turn it well.
Versare sopra il brodo bollente con gli: Pour the boiling broth with the spinach over it and serve at once; it does not keep.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 92: the pine nuts pounded in the mortar go into the soffritto, as in so many Genoese dishes, and the fried bread is turned in the yolks and milk before the broth is poured in.
Tritare la cipolla, la carota, il sedano: Chop the onion, carrot, celery, basil and parsley.
Metterli in una pentola con l'acqua, il: Put them in a pot with the water, salt and the halved ripe tomatoes.
Cuocere coperto a fuoco basso 2 ore e 30: Cook covered over a low heat for 2 hours 30 minutes.
Passare tutto al passaverdure, premendo: Pass everything through the food mill, pressing the herbs and tomatoes well.
Rimettere il liquido nella pentola, unir: Put the liquid back in the pot, add the butter and boil for 10-12 minutes.
Pour the boiling soup over the top.
Spolverizzare con il parmigiano grattugi: Sprinkle with the grated Parmigiano and serve; without bread it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 117: the tomatoes and herbs boil for about three hours before being passed through the sieve, «schiacciando e premendo bene» (crushing and pressing well) so that they give all their juice.
Sciogliere il burro in una casseruola e: Melt the butter in a casserole and heat it until it turns golden.
Unire la cipolla bianca grossa affettata: Add the large white onion, thinly sliced, and the flour and fry for 5 minutes, stirring.

Beat the yolks in a bowl.

Pour the soup over the top.
Servire subito col parmigiano grattugiat: Serve at once with the grated Parmigiano; it does not keep.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 118: twelve egg yolks for three litres of water, poured into the broth just taken off the heat «agitando, e rimestando assai bene, affinchè non si rappiglino» (shaking and stirring very well, so that they do not curdle).
Ammollare i funghi secchi in acqua tiepi: Soak the dried mushrooms in lukewarm water for 15 minutes, squeeze them and chop them with the parsley.
Rosolare la cipolla tritata nel burro 5: Brown the chopped onion in the butter for 5 minutes, then add the mushrooms and parsley and cook for 3 minutes.

Versare tutto nell'acqua salata bollente: Tip everything into the boiling salted water and after 5 minutes add 3 tablespoons of grated Parmigiano.
Aggiungere la panna e cuocere 30 minuti: Add the cream and cook for 30 minutes over a low heat.
Unire le uova sbattute, mescolare bene e: Add the beaten eggs, stir well and boil for 2 minutes.
Frullare i tuorli col latte e la maggior: Whisk the yolks with the milk and chopped marjoram and pour them in, stirring, until the soup comes back to the boil.
Tostare il pane raffermo a fette sulla g: Toast the stale bread in slices on the grill for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crisp, and put it in the tureen.
Versare la zuppa, spolverizzare col parm: Pour in the soup, sprinkle with the remaining Parmigiano, stir and serve; it does not keep.
Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genov: Emanuele Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), recipe 119: the «crema» is fior di latte, that is cream, which with the eggs and marjoram makes this lettuce soup velvety.
Tenere i fagioli borlotti secchi in ammo: Keep the dried borlotti beans soaking in cold water for 12 hours and drain them.
